newsitem.title: UK: Mortgages to boost UK creditor insurance market.
newsitem.headline: Mortgages to boost UK creditor insurance market.

text.p: Britain's market for loan related insurance will top 2.1 billion stg by 2002, compared with 1.4 billion stg in 1995, management consultancy Datamonitor said in a report on Tuesday.
Mortgage protection insurance will provide the main growth in this market, which is 62 percent controlled by specialist insurers.
Consolidated & Financial has a market share of more than 40 percent, composite insurers 23 percent and ITT 11 percent, Datamonitor said in the report entitled "UK loan related insurance."
